data.name: Hurl Tattoo
data.description: You gain the ability to throw your psionic tattoos with a range increment of 10 ft. as a ranged touch attack.  If the ranged touch attack is successful, the creature struck is affected by the power in the tattoo is of the struck creature had used the tattoo itself.
